policy.label: VVV launched with 100M tokens and an initial issuance rate of 14M VVV per year.
Venice burned another 1,030,001 VVV after buying back team tokens.
Tokenized DIEM launched with a published supply target of 38,000 DIEM.
Venice announced programmatic VVV buybacks and burns on new subscriptions.

Venice announced two further 500,000 VVV cuts to annual emissions, scheduled for September 1 and October 1.
